target.title: test(utils): add unit tests for formatTokenCount
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `formatTokenCount` utility in `src/utils/token-format.ts` already has base coverage in `src/utils/usage-format.test.ts` covering typical token counts (999, 1.2k, 12k, 999k, 1.0m, 2.5m). However, several edge cases were not tested: invalid inputs (undefined, NaN, Infinity), zero/negative clamping, exact boundary transitions (1k, 10k, 1m), and the thousands-to-millions rounding overflow path at 999,999. This PR fills those gaps.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add boundary and edge-case tests to the existing `usage-format.test.ts` covering:
- Invalid and non-finite input handling: `undefined`, `Number.NaN`, `Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY`, `Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY` → `"0"`
- Zero and negative value clamping: `0`, `-100` → `"0"`
- Exact thousands boundary: `1000` → `"1.0k"`
- Thousands midpoint: `1500` → `"1.5k"`
- Thousands boundary before no-decimal switch: `9999` → `"10.0k"`
- Whole-number thousands: `10000` → `"10k"`, `50000` → `"50k"`
- Exact millions boundary: `1_000_000` → `"1.0m"`
- Millions midpoint: `1_500_000` → `"1.5m"`
- Large millions: `10_000_000` → `"10.0m"`
- Thousands overflow to millions: `999_999` → `"1.0m"` (rounding crosses the k→m boundary)

This improves edge-case coverage for a widely-used formatting utility without churn.

## Reviewer Feedback

ClawSweeper [noted](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98541#issuecomment-4851659933) that `formatTokenCount` already had coverage through the existing `src/utils/usage-format.test.ts` and that adding a separate colocated test file overstated the gap. Per that feedback, this revision:
- **Dropped** the standalone `src/utils/token-format.test.ts` (46 lines)
- **Folded** the missing boundary and edge-case assertions into the existing `src/utils/usage-format.test.ts` (+25 lines across 4 new test cases)
- **Net**: −21 lines, no new files

## User Impact

No user-visible changes. The `formatTokenCount` contract around invalid inputs, zero/negative clamping, and boundary transitions is now tested.

## Evidence

Reproducibility: not applicable. This PR adds edge-case coverage to an existing test surface. Source inspection confirms the utility behavior the added tests target.

Direct behavior probe (no mocks — real functions exercised directly):

```text
$ node --import tsx -e "import('./src/utils/token-format.js').then((m) => {
  const r = [];
  r.push({ desc: 'exported function', fn: typeof m.formatTokenCount });
  r.push({ desc: 'undefined', result: m.formatTokenCount(undefined) });
  r.push({ desc: 'Number.NaN', result: m.formatTokenCount(Number.NaN) });
  r.push({ desc: 'Infinity', result: m.formatTokenCount(Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY) });
  r.push({ desc: 'zero', result: m.formatTokenCount(0) });
  r.push({ desc: 'negative', result: m.formatTokenCount(-100) });
  r.push({ desc: '1_000 (exact k boundary)', result: m.formatTokenCount(1_000) });
  r.push({ desc: '1_500', result: m.formatTokenCount(1_500) });
  r.push({ desc: '9_999', result: m.formatTokenCount(9_999) });
  r.push({ desc: '10_000', result: m.formatTokenCount(10_000) });
  r.push({ desc: '50_000', result: m.formatTokenCount(50_000) });
  r.push({ desc: '999_999 overflow to m', result: m.formatTokenCount(999_999) });
  r.push({ desc: '1_000_000 (exact m boundary)', result: m.formatTokenCount(1_000_000) });
  r.push({ desc: '1_500_000', result: m.formatTokenCount(1_500_000) });
  r.push({ desc: '10_000_000', result: m.formatTokenCount(10_000_000) });
  console.log(JSON.stringify(r, null, 2));
})"
[
  { "desc": "exported function", "fn": "function" },
  { "desc": "undefined", "result": "0" },
  { "desc": "Number.NaN", "result": "0" },
  { "desc": "Infinity", "result": "0" },
  { "desc": "zero", "result": "0" },
  { "desc": "negative", "result": "0" },
  { "desc": "1_000 (exact k boundary)", "result": "1.0k" },
  { "desc": "1_500", "result": "1.5k" },
  { "desc": "9_999", "result": "10.0k" },
  { "desc": "10_000", "result": "10k" },
  { "desc": "50_000", "result": "50k" },
  { "desc": "999_999 overflow to m", "result": "1.0m" },
  { "desc": "1_000_000 (exact m boundary)", "result": "1.0m" },
  { "desc": "1_500_000", "result": "1.5m" },
  { "desc": "10_000_000", "result": "10.0m" }
]
```

Targeted test:

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/utils/usage-format.test.ts

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  35 passed (35)
   Start at  18:49:22
   Duration  10.24s

[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 19.39s
```

Formatting:

```text
$ npx oxfmt --check src/utils/usage-format.test.ts
Checking formatting...

All matched files use the correct format.
```

Whitespace:

```text
$ git diff --check
```
